_meta.what: per-variant deposited-GERP values and their missingness for all nine species

columns.source: the deposited track file the row came from
columns.label: 1 = OMIA/ClinVar positive, 0 = population negative
columns.gerp: GERP score, NaN where the track has no value
columns.gerp_is_finite: whether GERP returned a value; this is the reach indicator

_meta.critical: Missingness is NaN, not null. Count it with isfinite; is_null reports 100% reach and deletes the result entirely.
_meta.note: cattle uses cattle_ensvar_gerp (cattle_gerp holds positives only) and dog uses dog_cf3_gerp on CanFam3.1; both are the files the published numbers come from.
_meta.verified: all nine per-species class gaps reproduce reports/fig5_reach.json to within 0.002
_meta.why_deposited: Referee gap analysis M4: the reach accounting was the arm a reader could not check.
